title: aw-ship at merge: write, every criterion proven
group: Fast route, with a verify skill
source: #55: at merge: write, aw-ship merges when each criterion is proven, on the real review report

assertions.name: the rollback plan names the merge commit, in the body and its open-review copy

assertions.judge: Merged by itself after checking every merge condition, and showed what proves each criterion: a test that passed in its full run, or a passed verify result

Each introduced-risk item of the review request body and its open-review copy, one per introduced risk in the review report, states that the risk was merged without a person's acceptance and is not ticked, and it never asked the user to accept a risk. The chat report names each introduced risk and says it was merged without acceptance, or says there were none when the report has none
